About the firm

Our services

RGAA auditAssessment of your websites and online services against France's General Accessibility Improvement Framework (RGAA). RAAM auditAudit of your iOS and Android apps on real devices, with native assistive technologies. Compliance auditAssessment against WCAG and EN 301 549, to meet the European Accessibility Act. Accessibility acceptance testingEvery release checked before going live, to avoid regressions. Real user testingYour key journeys tested by people with disabilities.
Accessible developmentSupport for your design and development teams, from mock-up to code. IT servicesFixes made by our developers on your code, CMS or documents. Recruitment supportRecruiting employees with disabilities and adapting their digital work environment.
Accessibility e-learningOnline courses to train your editorial, design and development teams at their own pace. TrainingOn-site or remote sessions, adapted to each role and to your tools.
See all services

An approach tailored to each organisation

Public sectorRegulatory audits, multi-year plans, accessibility statements and clauses for your public tenders. Large companiesMulti-site and multi-country compliance programmes, accessibility governance and team training. SMEsAudits sized to your website or online shop, with a realistic action plan.

A European firm, one standard per country.

Our audits are based on the European standard EN 301 549 and on the applicable national standard.
